notes: Full description: OcspChecker::check_revocation (pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs:91-216) and check_revocation_against_anchor (lines 234-336) share nearly identical implementations for steps (1-5) parse + status + bytes + type + BasicOCSPResponse, (6-6b) signature verify + responder ID, (7-7a) serial search + CertID hash checks, and (8-9) validity window + cert status. The two methods differ only in whether the issuer identity comes from &Certificate or &TrustAnchor. The duplicated code is ~150 lines. Fix: extract a private helper function 'check_ocsp_response(basic, issuer_name, issuer_spki, cert, now_unix)' that handles the shared logic, called by both methods after parsing and signature verification. The per-path responder ID check (verify_responder_id vs verify_responder_id_anchor) would remain distinct. This removes the maintenance hazard of needing to update two code paths for every OCSP behavior change.
title: RUSTY: OcspChecker check_revocation paths duplicated
